assumptions: The public repository describes a one-minute trailer at 2.39:1; this adaptation uses 60 seconds at 1920×804. Source: https://github.com/ishuagrawal/particle-beach
Time of day follows an editable simulated dawn-to-midnight progression, with interactive time buttons and scrubbing, rather than accessing the current clock.

Beach layout, camera path, crowds, colors and motion are original artistic choices, not a geographically exact reconstruction. The pier and Ferris-wheel context was checked against https://www.santamonicapier.org/.

All artwork is procedural; no repository code, photographs, logos or other external assets are incorporated. The repository lists an MIT license, but its full license text could not be retrieved. GSAP is supplied by the harness; its license was not independently assessed.
The supplied starting prompt is implemented as a silent animation. Unprovided follow-up prompts are outside this adaptation. This output has not been executed, rendered or visually reviewed.
